blocks.text: Present Perfect 2: tajriba va tugamagan davr

7-darsda Present Perfect ning hozirgi natija va yangilik ma'nolarini ko'rdik. Bu darsda yana ikki ma'nosi: **hayot tajribasi** (Have you ever ...?) va **hali tugamagan davr** ichidagi harakatlar (today, this week, this year, so far). Ikkalasining umumiy jihati — o'tmishdan **hozirgacha** cho'zilgan davr: «hayotim davomida», «bugun ertalabdan beri», «shu yil boshidan hozirgacha». Qizil kitobda ever va never o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 17-dars), bu yerda chuqurroq ko'ramiz.

«Hayotimda shunday bo'lganmi?» degan savolda davr — butun hayot, u hali tugamagan. Shuning uchun Present Perfect: **Have** you ever **been** to London? Javobdagi **tafsilotlar** (qachon, kim bilan, qanday) esa Past Simple bilan beriladi, chunki ular aniq o'tgan voqea: Yes, I **went** there in 2019. O'zbekchada tajriba ko'pincha «**-gan**» bilan ifodalanadi: bo'lgan**man**, ko'rmagan**man**.

items.text: **Have** you ever **been** to London? — Yes, I **went** there in 2019.
I**'ve never ridden** a horse, but I'd love to try.
items.translation: Hech qachon ot **minmaganman**, lekin sinab ko'rishni juda xohlardim.

blocks.text: It's the first time ... va eng ... I've ever ...

**It's the first (second, third) time** + Present Perfect — «birinchi (ikkinchi) marta». Bu yerda o'zbek o'quvchi ko'p xato qiladi, chunki o'zbekchada hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: «Londonda **birinchi marta** mashina **haydayapman**» → It's the first time I**'ve driven** in London («... I drive» ✗). Xuddi shunday orttirma daraja + **ever**: It's the best book I**'ve ever read** — «Men **o'qigan** eng yaxshi kitob». O'tmishdagi «birinchi marta» uchun Past Perfect kerak bo'ladi (→ 15-dars).

items.text: It's the first time I**'ve eaten** sushi.
It's the best book I**'ve ever read**.

blocks.text: Tugamagan davr: today, this week, this year

Davr hali **davom etayotgan** bo'lsa (today, this week, this month, this year), Present Perfect ishlatiladi: harakat shu davrning ichida, davr esa hozirgacha cho'zilgan. Davr **tugagan** bo'lsa — Past Simple. Eng nozik holat — **this morning**: soat o'n birda «**Have** you **seen** Kate this morning?» (ertalab hali tugamagan), lekin kunduzi soat uchda «**Did** you **see** Kate this morning?» (ertalab tugagan). Batafsil → 14-dars.

rows: We**'ve had** a lot of rain this year.
We **had** a lot of rain last year.

blocks.text: recently, lately, so far, in the last few days

Bu so'zlar ham hozirgacha davom etgan davrni bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Perfect bilan keladi: **recently / lately** — so'nggi paytlarda, yaqinda; **so far** — hozircha, shu paytgacha; **in the last few days / weeks / years** — so'nggi bir necha kun (hafta, yil) ichida. Savollar: **How many times ...?**, **How much ... so far?** — natija hozirgacha sanaladi.

items.text: So far we**'ve visited** two museums and the old bazaar.
items.translation: Hozircha ikkita muzey va eski bozorni **ko'rdik**.

items.text: Kate **has changed** jobs twice in the last three years.
items.translation: So'nggi uch yilda Keyt ikki marta ish **almashtirdi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Did you ever been to London?» → **Have** you ever **been** to London?; «It's the first time I drive in London.» → It's the first time I**'ve driven** in London.; «I never saw such a beautiful city.» (hayot tajribasi) → I**'ve never seen** such a beautiful city.; tushdan keyin «This morning I've drunk too much coffee.» → This morning I **drank** too much coffee.; «I have been in London in 2019.» → I **was** in London in 2019. (aniq yil — Past Simple).

Davrni tekshiring: u **hozir ham davom etyaptimi**? «Bugun», «shu hafta», «hayotimda», «hozircha» — hali tugamagan → Present Perfect. «Kecha», «o'tgan hafta», «bolaligimda», «2019-yilda» — tugagan → Past Simple.

for va since → 12-dars; Present Perfect yoki Past Simple tanlash → 13–14-darslar; o'tmishdagi «birinchi marta» (It was the first time I**'d seen** snow) → 15-dars. Uzoq davom etgan jarayon (I**'ve been working** all day) → 9-dars.

rows: **Have** you ever **tried** horse riding? I**'ve never tried** it.
It's the first time I**'ve driven** in London.
It's the worst film I**'ve ever seen**.
So far we**'ve sold** two hundred tickets.

examples.title: Life experience: Have you ever ...?
examples.description: Hayot tajribasi — davr butun hayot, u hali tugamagan: Have you ever + V3? O'zbekchada «hech ... -ganmisiz?». Javobdagi tafsilotlar — Past Simple.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **tried** horse meat? — Yes, my uncle cooks it every winter.
sentences.translation: Hech ot go'shtini **tatib ko'rganmisiz**? — Ha, amakim har qishda pishiradi.

sentences.text: **Has** Oliver ever **visited** a mosque? — Yes, he **went** to one in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Oliver hech masjidga **kirganmi**? — Ha, Buxorodagi bittasiga **borgan**.

sentences.text: I**'ve worked** in three different countries, so I know how hard it is to start again.
sentences.translation: Uch xil mamlakatda **ishlaganman**, shuning uchun qaytadan boshlash qanchalik qiyinligini bilaman.

sentences.text: Madina **has met** a lot of famous people because of her job at the TV station.
sentences.translation: Madina televideniyedagi ishi tufayli ko'plab mashhur odamlar bilan **uchrashgan**.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **lost** your luggage at an airport? — Once, in Istanbul.
sentences.translation: Hech aeroportda yukingizni **yo'qotganmisiz**? — Bir marta, Istanbulda.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has read** every book in his library at least twice.
sentences.translation: Bobom kutubxonasidagi har bir kitobni kamida ikki marta **o'qib chiqqan**.

sentences.text: Kate **has run** two marathons, and she's training for a third.
sentences.translation: Keyt ikkita marafonda **yugurgan**, hozir uchinchisiga tayyorlanyapti.

sentences.text: How many countries **have** you **been** to? — About fifteen, I think.
sentences.translation: Nechta mamlakatda **bo'lgansiz**? — O'n beshtacha, shekilli.

sentences.text: We**'ve stayed** in that hotel before, and the service was excellent.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonada **oldin ham to'xtaganmiz**, xizmat a'lo darajada edi.

sentences.text: **Has** anyone in your family ever **won** a prize in a competition?
sentences.translation: Oilangizda hech kim biror musobaqada **sovrin yutganmi**?

examples.title: **never** and **before**
examples.description: never — hech qachon (... -maganman); before — oldin ham. never ... before — hozir birinchi marta bo'layotgan narsa haqida.

sentences.text: I**'ve never been** on a plane, so I'm a bit nervous about the trip.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon samolyotda **uchmaganman**, shuning uchun safardan biroz xavotirdaman.

sentences.text: Jasur **has never missed** a single training session in five years.
sentences.translation: Jasur besh yil ichida birorta ham mashg'ulotni **qoldirmagan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve never had** such a hot summer in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda hech qachon bunday issiq yoz **bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has never eaten** plov before, so let's take her to the Plov Centre.
sentences.translation: Sara oldin hech qachon palov **yemagan**, uni Osh markaziga olib boraylik.

sentences.text: Funnily enough, my parents **have never argued** in front of us.
sentences.translation: Qizig'i shundaki, ota-onam hech qachon bizning oldimizda **janjallashmagan**.

sentences.text: That's strange — I**'ve never seen** this man before, but he knows my name.
sentences.translation: G'alati — bu odamni oldin hech qachon **ko'rmaganman**, lekin u ismimni biladi.

sentences.text: **Have** you **done** this kind of work before? — No, never, but I learn fast.
sentences.translation: Oldin ham bunday ish **qilganmisiz**? — Yo'q, hech qachon, lekin tez o'rganaman.

sentences.text: The museum **has never been** so crowded — the queue goes round the block.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda hech qachon bunchalik odam ko'p **bo'lmagan** — navbat kvartalni aylanib ketibdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has never been** abroad, but he speaks English like a native.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hech qachon chet elda **bo'lmagan**, lekin ingliz tilida ona tilidek gapiradi.

sentences.text: Nobody in our office **has** ever **complained** about the new manager.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda hech kim yangi menejerdan **shikoyat qilmagan**.

examples.title: It's the first time I**'ve** ...
examples.description: It's / This is the first (second, third) time + Present Perfect. O'zbekchada ko'pincha hozirgi zamon — «birinchi marta ... -yapman», inglizchada esa faqat Present Perfect.

sentences.text: This is the first time I**'ve driven** in London, and the traffic is terrifying.
sentences.translation: Londonda **birinchi marta mashina haydayapman**, tirbandlik esa dahshatli.

sentences.text: It's the second time Tom **has forgotten** our anniversary!
sentences.translation: Tom to'y yilligimizni **ikkinchi marta unutyapti**!

sentences.text: Is this the first time you**'ve visited** Uzbekistan? — Yes, and I love it.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonga **birinchi marta kelishingizmi**? — Ha, menga juda yoqyapti.

sentences.text: This is the third time the printer **has jammed** this morning.
sentences.translation: Printer bugun ertalab **uchinchi marta tiqilib qoldi**.

sentences.text: It's the first time Madina **has cooked** for so many guests.
sentences.translation: Madina shuncha mehmonga **birinchi marta ovqat pishiryapti**.

sentences.text: Snow in April! It's the first time we**'ve seen** that here.
sentences.translation: Aprelda qor! Bu yerda buni **birinchi marta ko'ryapmiz**.

sentences.text: Is it the first time your son **has been** away from home?
sentences.translation: O'g'lingiz uydan **birinchi marta** uzoqda **bo'lyaptimi**?

sentences.text: Believe it or not, this is only the second time I**'ve flown** business class.
sentences.translation: Ishonasizmi-yo'qmi, biznes klassda **bor-yo'g'i ikkinchi marta uchyapman**.

sentences.text: That's the fourth time you**'ve asked** me the same question today!
sentences.translation: Bugun menga bir xil savolni **to'rtinchi marta beryapsan**!

sentences.text: For Aziz, it's the first time he**'s worked** in a team where nobody speaks Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Aziz hech kim o'zbekcha gapirmaydigan jamoada **birinchi marta ishlayapti**.

examples.title: The best ... I**'ve** ever ...
examples.description: Orttirma daraja + ever + Present Perfect: the best / worst / most ... I've ever ... O'zbekchada «men ko'rgan eng ...», «umrimda ... eng ...».

sentences.text: This is the best plov I**'ve ever eaten**, and I've tried plenty!
sentences.translation: Bu men **yegan** eng mazali palov, holbuki ko'p palov tatib ko'rganman!

sentences.text: That was the most boring lecture I**'ve ever sat** through.
sentences.translation: Bu umrimda **eshitgan** eng zerikarli ma'ruza edi.

sentences.text: Emma is the kindest person I**'ve ever met**.
sentences.translation: Emma men **uchratgan** eng mehribon inson.

sentences.text: What's the most dangerous thing you**'ve ever done**?
sentences.translation: Umringizda **qilgan** eng xavfli ishingiz nima?

sentences.text: Edinburgh is one of the most beautiful cities we**'ve ever visited**.
sentences.translation: Edinburg biz **borgan** eng go'zal shaharlardan biri.

sentences.text: It's the worst hotel I**'ve ever stayed** in — the room smells of smoke.
sentences.translation: Bu men **to'xtagan** eng yomon mehmonxona — xonadan tutun hidi kelyapti.

sentences.text: Who is the most famous person you**'ve ever talked** to?
sentences.translation: Siz **gaplashgan** eng mashhur odam kim?

sentences.text: Jasur says this is the hardest exam he**'s ever taken**.
sentences.translation: Jasurning aytishicha, bu u **topshirgan** eng qiyin imtihon.

sentences.text: Last night's thunder was the loudest I**'ve ever heard**.
sentences.translation: Kechagi momaqaldiroq umrimda **eshitgan** eng kuchli momaqaldiroq bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The view from the top of Big Chimgan is the most amazing sight I**'ve ever seen**.
sentences.translation: Katta Chimyon cho'qqisidan ochiladigan manzara men **ko'rgan** eng hayratlanarli manzara.

examples.title: Unfinished periods: today, this week, this year
examples.description: Davr hali tugamagan bo'lsa (today, this morning — hali ertalab bo'lsa, this week, this year) — Present Perfect. Davr tugagan bo'lsa — Past Simple (→ 14-dars).

sentences.text: I**'ve drunk** four cups of coffee today, and it's only eleven o'clock.
sentences.translation: Bugun to'rt piyola qahva **ichdim**, soat esa endi o'n bir.

sentences.text: **Have** you **seen** Kate this morning? She isn't answering her phone.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab Keytni **ko'rdingizmi**? Telefonini ko'tarmayapti.

sentences.text: We **haven't had** a single day off this month.
sentences.translation: Bu oy bir kun ham **dam olganimiz yo'q**.

sentences.text: The company **has hired** twenty new engineers this year.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya bu yil yigirmata yangi muhandisni **ishga oldi**.

sentences.text: It**'s rained** every day this week, so the football pitch is a swamp.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta har kuni yomg'ir **yog'di**, futbol maydoni botqoqqa aylandi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **hasn't been** to the gym this week because of her cold.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza shamollagani uchun bu hafta sport zaliga **bormadi**.

sentences.text: How many emails **have** you **answered** today? — Not many, to be honest.
sentences.translation: Bugun nechta xatga **javob berdingiz**? — Rostini aytsam, ko'p emas.

sentences.text: Tom **has worked** late three times this week — he looks exhausted.
sentences.translation: Tom bu hafta uch marta ishda **kech qoldi** — juda charchaganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Yesterday I **did** a lot of work, but today I**'ve done** almost nothing.
sentences.translation: Kecha ko'p ish **qildim**, bugun esa deyarli hech narsa **qilmadim**.

sentences.text: Sales **have been** much better this quarter than last quarter.
sentences.translation: Bu chorakda sotuvlar o'tgan chorakdagidan ancha yaxshi **bo'ldi**.

examples.title: **recently**, **lately**, **so far**
examples.description: recently / lately — so'nggi paytlarda, yaqinda; so far — hozircha, shu paytgacha; in the last few days / weeks — so'nggi bir necha kun ichida.

sentences.text: **Have** you **read** any good books recently? I need something for the holiday.
sentences.translation: Yaqinda biror yaxshi kitob **o'qidingizmi**? Ta'til uchun biror narsa kerak.

sentences.text: Prices for flats in Tashkent **have risen** a lot lately.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda Toshkentda kvartira narxlari ancha **oshdi**.

sentences.text: So far we**'ve sold** two hundred tickets, but we need at least five hundred.
sentences.translation: Hozircha ikki yuzta chipta **sotdik**, lekin kamida besh yuzta kerak.

sentences.text: I **haven't heard** from Bekzod in the last few weeks — is he OK?
sentences.translation: So'nggi bir necha hafta ichida Bekzoddan **xabar bo'lmadi** — u yaxshimi?

sentences.text: Nilufar **has lost** five kilos recently, thanks to her new diet.
sentences.translation: Yangi parhezi tufayli Nilufar yaqinda besh kilo **ozdi**.

sentences.text: How many chapters **have** you **written** so far? — Six out of ten.
sentences.translation: Hozircha nechta bob **yozdingiz**? — O'ntadan oltitasini.

sentences.text: There **have been** several accidents on this road in the last month.
sentences.translation: So'nggi bir oyda bu yo'lda bir nechta avariya **sodir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Lately James **hasn't seemed** very happy at work.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda Jeyms ishda unchalik xursand **ko'rinmayapti**.

sentences.text: The new app **has had** over a million downloads so far.
sentences.translation: Yangi ilova hozircha bir milliondan ortiq marta **yuklab olindi**.

sentences.text: Scientists **have made** huge progress in cancer research in the last ten years.
sentences.translation: So'nggi o'n yilda olimlar saraton tadqiqotlarida ulkan yutuqlarga **erishdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a job interview
examples.description: Ish suhbati: tajriba haqida savollar (Have you ever ...?), hozirgacha qilingan ishlar va tafsilotlar uchun Past Simple.

sentences.text: — So, Ms Karimova, **have** you ever **managed** a team before?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Karimova xonim, oldin hech jamoani **boshqarganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'ve led** small teams on several projects at my current company.
sentences.translation: — Ha, hozirgi kompaniyamda bir nechta loyihada kichik jamoalarni **boshqarganman**.

sentences.text: — And **have** you **worked** with international clients?
sentences.translation: — Xalqaro mijozlar bilan **ishlaganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — Many times. Last year I **spent** three months with a client in Manchester.
sentences.translation: — Ko'p marta. O'tgan yili Manchesterdagi bir mijoz bilan uch oy **ishladim**.

sentences.text: — Impressive. What's the hardest problem you**'ve** ever **solved** at work?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Ishda **hal qilgan** eng qiyin muammoingiz qaysi?

sentences.text: — Once our server **crashed** the night before a big launch, and we **fixed** it by morning.
sentences.translation: — Bir safar katta taqdimot arafasida serverimiz **ishdan chiqdi**, biz uni tonggacha **tuzatdik**.

sentences.text: — I see. **Have** you ever **used** our software?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Bizning dasturimizdan hech **foydalanganmisiz**?

sentences.text: — I**'ve** only **tried** the free version, but I**'ve watched** all your tutorials.
sentences.translation: — Faqat bepul versiyasini **sinab ko'rganman**, lekin barcha video darsliklaringizni **ko'rib chiqqanman**.

sentences.text: — Good. How many interviews **have** you **had** this month?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Bu oy nechta suhbatda **qatnashdingiz**?

sentences.text: — This is the first one, actually — I**'ve** never **applied** anywhere else.
sentences.translation: — Aslida, bu birinchisi — boshqa hech qayerga **ariza topshirmaganman**.

examples.title: Mixed: experience, records and this year's news
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: tajriba, «birinchi marta», orttirma daraja, tugamagan davr va recently / so far — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan **has never hosted** the Olympic Games, but it **has organised** many big tournaments.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston hech qachon Olimpiada o'yinlarini **o'tkazmagan**, lekin ko'plab yirik turnirlarni **tashkil qilgan**.

sentences.text: This year our team **has won** every match so far, which is a club record.
sentences.translation: Bu yil jamoamiz hozircha barcha o'yinlarda **g'alaba qozondi**, bu klub rekordi.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **wondered** why the sky in Khiva looks so blue?
sentences.translation: Hech **o'ylab ko'rganmisiz**, nega Xivada osmon bunchalik moviy ko'rinadi?

sentences.text: It's the third time the bank **has changed** its app this year, and I still can't find anything.
sentences.translation: Bank bu yil ilovasini **uchinchi marta o'zgartirdi**, men esa hali ham hech narsani topa olmayapman.

sentences.text: Sarah **has visited** Samarkand twice, but she **hasn't seen** Bukhara yet.
sentences.translation: Sara Samarqandga ikki marta **borgan**, lekin Buxoroni **hali ko'rgani yo'q**.

sentences.text: My son **has grown** five centimetres in the last six months!
sentences.translation: So'nggi olti oyda o'g'lim besh santimetr **o'sdi**!

sentences.text: That's the most expensive coffee I**'ve ever bought**, and it wasn't even good.
sentences.translation: Bu men **sotib olgan** eng qimmat qahva, ustiga-ustak, mazali ham emas edi.

sentences.text: How many times **has** Oliver **been** late this week? — Four, I think.
sentences.translation: Oliver bu hafta necha marta **kechikdi**? — To'rt marta, shekilli.

sentences.text: Recently more and more Uzbek students **have chosen** universities in Britain.
sentences.translation: So'nggi paytlarda tobora ko'proq o'zbek talabalari Britaniya universitetlarini **tanlamoqda**.

sentences.text: I**'ve** never **understood** why people queue all night for a new phone.
sentences.translation: Odamlar nega yangi telefon uchun tun bo'yi navbatda turishini hech qachon **tushunmaganman**.
